epistemic_status: NEW exploratory predictor diagnostic after all earlier 2010–2012 photo, 83 MODIS scene, site NDVI-difference and prior 3 rho results were opened. Not an untouched test, no causal identification.
research_question: Does the same camera's PHOTO-count change depend more clearly on the average absolute green environment or changes in its vegetation rank among peer cameras, rather than simply greenness difference, when solar daylength is matched?

frozen_sample.matched_camera_dates: Reuse EXACT 24,290 sunrise/sunset + 1 minute-source calendar mirrors, 2010, 2011, 2012 December21 +/-7..180 days.
frozen_sample.original_NDVI: All 83 original MOD13Q1 Terra V061 scenes, same 3x3 250m QA reliability 0 ONLY >=6 good pixels, most recently completed composite age<=20 days, no forward lookahead or interpolation
frozen_sample.year_site_NDVI: At each original physical station+year with >=10 2-branch good matched NDVI pairs and >=60% of source astronomy-date roster quality support, compute mean original rising NDVI R_i, mean falling NDVI F_i and delta_i=F_i-R_i using exactly the old admitted satellite date pairs.
frozen_sample.relative_rank: Among ALL independent NDVI-quality-admitted original camera sites IN SAME year (not selected by animal detections), calculate midrank of R_i and F_i separately, scaled to [0,1]. Define rank_shift_i=relative_rank(F_i)-relative_rank(R_i); this is zero if a site does not change greenness rank among the original cameras.
frozen_sample.photo_sample: Retain the source original photo-only `>=5` deduplicated records per branch per focal species on the same satellite-qualified date sets; site chosen by co-photo detection. Keep original 15 source taxon×year records and original source coverage.
frozen_sample.reporting_gate: At least 15 original distinct cameras with >=5 source photos on BOTH branches and >=50% of original first-photo branch-record support; EXACT gate as original source first NDVI paper. Must preserve original 3 supported [zebra 2011, zebra 2012, wildebeest 2011], all 12 other cells unavailable.

fixed_covariates.name: delta_NDVI
fixed_covariates.definition: mean F_i - mean R_i for the same source paired days; replay old rho as a first gate, DO NOT reinterpret previous values

fixed_covariates.name: mean_level_NDVI
fixed_covariates.definition: (mean F_i + mean R_i)/2 — where vegetation is typically greener, not how much site greens up

fixed_covariates.name: relative_rank_shift
fixed_covariates.definition: mean-rank percentile F_i minus mean-rank percentile R_i across ALL original QA-qualified cameras in a calendar year, independent of focal-species photo co-detection

fixed_observed_outcomes: log(N_falling_photo/N_rising_photo) at same physical camera and original satellite-quality date-pair source sample; NOT effort-corrected animal activity or residence
NIGHT-photo fraction falling minus rising on same photo-positive source camera; NOT latent animal nocturnality

fixed_statistics.primary: Spearman midrank rho for every predictor×outcome×focal species×year, including undefined, plus camera count/coverage and leave-one-physical-camera-out min–max (NOT confidence intervals).
fixed_statistics.photo_outcome_independence: No p-values; repeated camera photographs and calendar pairs are not independent wildlife individuals.
fixed_statistics.previous_result_requirements: Before opening new predictors re-reproduce exactly all 15 original supported status/sample sizes and old delta-NDVI Spearman rhos (absolute tolerance <= 1e-10). Fail HOLD otherwise.
fixed_statistics.hypothesized_pattern: Camera-relative NDVI rank shift could be more relevant to seasonal photo-location reweighting than common regional greenup: compare sign and absolute rho magnitude to original delta-NDVI within the same preadmitted rows. No selecting whichever predictor gives better result ex post.
fixed_statistics.year_result: Include full distribution range and site count for mean_level_NDVI and relative_rank_shift across all 98/112/112 NDVI-ready camera-years without publishing exact site coordinates.

red_lines: One ecosystem, at most 3 annual cycles, 3 earlier photo-gated supported taxon-years; cannot demonstrate universal photoperiod ecological memory.

All 322 originally admitted site-years may green up yet camera-specific photo counts need not correspond; positive or negative rank effects cannot be marketed as migration without independent movement and verified camera-hour q.
Original hardware model/flash changes between 2010 and 2012; no independent date×solar-zone power ON/OFF camera operation.
Pixel NDVI measures foliage reflectance including woody cover and camera setting, not edible grass forage biomass.
Output only aggregate year×taxon correlations, QA/source coverage and no source station IDs, precise coordinates, original event datetimes or individual vegetation pixels.
Do not retroactively relabel archived v0 SOURCE PHOTO and prior qualified original results.
